course_info.trial_description: In your trial English lesson, we’ll start by meeting and getting to know each other, so I can assess your level, understand your goals and what you want from future lessons. We will focus on practical skills like conversation, grammar, and vocabulary. You’ll experience an interactive, fun class where you can practice comfortably. I provide a supportive environment, encouraging you to learn through participation. Afterward, I’ll give you personalized feedback and discuss the best steps forward to help you achieve your language goals.

pro_course_detail.title: English for beginners
pro_course_detail.description: My Basic English for Beginners class is designed to help those new to English build a strong foundation in the language. In this class, we’ll focus on essential skills like simple vocabulary, common phrases, and basic grammar structures. You'll learn how to introduce yourself, ask and answer everyday questions, and hold simple conversations. Lessons are interactive and practical, ensuring you practice speaking, listening, reading, and writing in a supportive environment. With clear explanations and lots of practice, this class will give you the confidence to start using English in real-life situations from day one.

pro_course_detail.title: English classes - intermediate  level
pro_course_detail.description: My Intermediate English (B1 Level) class is perfect for learners who have a basic understanding of English and want to take their skills to the next level. In this class, we focus on improving fluency, expanding vocabulary, and mastering more complex grammar structures. You’ll engage in conversations on a variety of everyday topics, improve your listening and speaking skills, and practice writing short texts like emails or stories. Lessons are interactive, with activities that challenge you to use English in real-life situations. By the end, you’ll feel more confident expressing ideas, asking questions, and understanding English in various contexts.

pro_course_detail.title: English classes - Upper intermediate
pro_course_detail.description: My Upper Intermediate English (B2 Level) class is designed for learners who want to refine their language skills and gain greater fluency and accuracy. In this class, we focus on advanced grammar, nuanced vocabulary, and more complex sentence structures. You’ll practice discussing a wide range of topics in depth, improving your ability to express opinions, debate, and understand more sophisticated texts. The lessons are highly interactive, with a strong emphasis on real-world communication, critical thinking, and clear expression. By the end of the course, you’ll feel confident using English in both professional and social contexts, ready for more advanced conversations and tasks.

pro_course_detail.title: English classes - Advanced
pro_course_detail.description: My Advanced English (C1 Level) class is designed for learners who are ready to master the language and communicate with fluency and precision. In this class, we focus on refining your understanding of complex grammar, expanding your vocabulary with idiomatic expressions, and developing a more sophisticated style in both writing and speaking. You’ll engage in in-depth discussions on a variety of topics, critically analyse texts, and improve your ability to present arguments and ideas clearly. The lessons are highly interactive, challenging you to think in English and communicate with confidence in any setting—academic, professional, or social.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English Classes
pro_course_detail.description: My Business English class is tailored for professionals looking to enhance their communication skills in a corporate or business environment. This class focuses on practical language used in meetings, presentations, negotiations, and email correspondence. You’ll learn essential business vocabulary, formal expressions, and strategies for effective communication in professional settings. Through real-world case studies, role-playing, and discussions, you’ll practice handling business situations with confidence and clarity. Whether it’s leading a meeting, negotiating a deal, or networking with international clients, this course will help you use English effectively to advance your career.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversational Lessons
pro_course_detail.description: My Conversational English lessons are designed to help you build confidence and fluency in everyday speaking situations. The focus is on real-life communication, where you’ll practice expressing your thoughts, sharing opinions, and engaging in discussions on a variety of topics like travel, culture, current events, and more. These lessons are interactive and relaxed, allowing you to improve your listening and speaking skills through natural, flowing conversations. You’ll also learn useful phrases, improve pronunciation, and gain the confidence to speak English comfortably in social and informal settings.
